laws.name: Servo blend
laws.author: Hertzforge contributors
laws.summary: Moves the tone's amplitude each tick by a proportional-integral servo on the error in dB, blended with the identification's prediction of the drive at the present frequency. The controller caps every change and holds the drive under the limit channels and the drive ceiling.

params.label: Prediction weight
params.help: How much of each tick's change follows the identification's prediction of the drive (1) rather than the servo on the measured error (0). It can be changed while the test runs.

params.label: Compression
params.help: How fast the servo corrects: slow (integral gain 2, at most 20 dB/s), fast (6, at most 60 dB/s), or custom with the two values below.

params.label: Integral gain
params.help: The servo's integral gain, with custom compression.

params.label: Largest servo rate
params.help: The fastest the servo moves the drive, with custom compression.

params.label: Proportional gain
params.help: The servo's proportional gain on the error in dB.

diagnostics.label: Servo step
diagnostics.help: The servo's part of the last tick's change.

diagnostics.label: Prediction step
diagnostics.help: The prediction's part of the last tick's change.

diagnostics.label: Total step
diagnostics.help: The change the law asked for on the last tick, before the controller's caps.

diagnostics.label: Servo level
diagnostics.help: The servo's own drive level after the last tick, in dB relative to one drive unit.
